notes.title: Do you plan a mods support?
notes.content:
This is pretty frequently asked question so it's deserve the separate post.
And the answer is no.

But why?

From the one side, a mods can provide a lot of funny content even if developers of the game don't work on it anymore.

But from the other side, we're not really like the quality of most mods. Or mod just didn't fit the game style, flying pony in the space, for example. Of course you can just not install it but there is begins problem with the multiplayer compatibility.

Another problem, most mods it is something visual, 3d models or textures, the good gameplay mod is much rare thing, but not this is a problem.
The problem is that almost all gameplay mods is so obvious so we just cannot understand why developers of the game didn't made this feature and don't put it in the game by default?

Developers of the mods will spend a much more time to figure out with the engine when the developers, who is  familiar with their game, can create it a lot more faster and more quality.

So, instead of mods support, we want to implement all cool requested features so we will be sure in quality and compatibility with the other game features.

notes.title: Update 0.51 Pre-Alpha
notes.content:
Hello, dear followers. We are glad to inform you that we can please you with an update already on the next day after release! At first we thought that we will make an updates every week, but now we feel that we're able to make an updates every few days, or even every day! Seems like it would be pleasant and for you and for us.

We worked on your requests and bug reports, plus radar was totally reworked and added one new cannon. Not all of the planned bugfixes and features have been implemented, but we will continue tomorrow.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/2014-11-22_024813.jpg[/img]

We want note that your idea of automatic construction for drones made the gameplay much more enjoyable. As you see, we don't want to load you pointless chore, so feel free to suggest any radical changes in the game. Now we are sure that we've launched an early access just right in time, we get a lot of ideas and bug reports that would be impossible before Early Access.

[h1]Full change log[/h1]

[b]Major improvements and gameplay changes[/b]
[list]
 [*]Now radars creates only one marker per detected ship, instead of creating a bunch of markers for each module of the ship
 [*]Radar's markers now changes their color and form according to the faction and type of the associated object
 [*]When several nearby radars detects the same object, this object have only one marker, instead of several markers per each radar
 [*]Now you can click on the marker to select associated object

 [*]Now when you start to building a module, all drones of the active ship automatically takes an order to finish the module, so you no longer need to give these orders manually

 [*]Added a new weapon, Energy Pulse Cannon
[/list]
[b]Minor improvements and bug fixes[/b]
[list]
 [*]When you press “New Ship” button, the new ship will be placed in random point around the ship, this should lower a chance that it will be destroyed right after creation. This is temporary fix, later the process of building a new ship would be more correct.

 [*]If the current ship was lost, control will be switched to another ship automatically after 3 seconds

 [*]Background music now have the maximum playback priority and it is not interrupted when the game is filled with a lot of sounds

 [*]Now you can't give the drone an order to build the same module multiple times
 [*]Now you can't give the drone an order to "build myself" or build one of the starting modules which is already built

 [*]Redesign of Developers and Options panels
 [*]Redesign of Early Access panel in the right-bottom corner of the main menu screen
 [*]Multiplayer button is temporarily disabled
 [*]Exit button from ingame menu, now returns you to the main menu, instead of close application

 [*]Fire cone of large turret lowered from 120 to 30 degrees and turn speed from 30 to 12 deg\s
[/list]

notes.title: Prerelease preparations and some thoughts
notes.content:
Hello dear followers!
Sorry for no news from us for such a long time. The release date is closer and closer, we're trying to fix bugs as quickly as possible but seems like we need more time.

The whole past week we have been busy on bug fixes and content improvement. Besides, we trying to understand how to work with Steam and make a proper build. Seems like we almost done with it. 

But the game is not ready yet to launch...

Interesting thing. Creating of various features is not enough to make a "game". We just analyze many reviews from various early access games and noticed that people don't like when the game have no any goal. The game may have nice graphic, some basic features, but don't have actually "gameplay".

And it makes sense. Let's take for example the FTL, but imagine that all weapons, upgrades and crew is available on the start. Such a game will become boring after 20 minutes of playing. Or let's take any other game and imagine that you have everything on the start. It will be not very interesting. So this is a current state of Celestial Command, and we're not very happy with this fact.

We noticed that some early access games have even less features and more bugs than Celestial Command have now, and people are still satisfied. But we want to use one additional week to make the game slightly better.

So right now we're working on a quests. It will be pretty simple system for now, but we think that even few randomly generated goals will make game much better.
Probably we should implement some kind of money, reputation and upgrades. Seems like learning curve and possibility to gradually open new technology is very important factors for attractive gameplay.

By the way, this is not very pleasant paradox. Some games have a lot of possibilities but have no gameplay goals, while another games, almost have no any possibilities, but can attract players due long and smooth growing curve or just due online score board.

You can just browse games in the Steam and make note that lot's of simple arcade games have almost perfect reviews, while many interesting sandbox games have a lots of frustrated players. Of course It makes sense, more complicated plans is harder to realize, but anyway, it's quite a sad.

Or maybe we just too worried before release. :)

So! We hope that new release date is November 20. If no, it will be in this month anyway.

By the way! Early access will be available for PC, Linux and SteamOS (when it will be available). But we have some problem with Mac, so release on the Mac will be available later.

notes.title: New Editor, UI and Release Information
notes.content:
Hello again dear followers!
Sorry for no news from us for such a long time, but we have been very focused on some important tasks and now we can share the progress with you.

(Warning, 20 Mb of GIF animations inside)

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/2014-10-23_033920.png[/img]

[h1]Release Date[/h1]

First of all about release date. We thought to open early access before 17 October. We done almost all required papers for a one week, but for the last one, turned out that we need to wait up to 30 days!

Yes, it's sad, but we need to wait... Hopefully we won't have to wait so long and we will get an answer sooner.

But don't worry! We have another good news for you!

To be honest, the game is not ready yet for launch (in our idealistic view), so we use the additional time to make the game even better!


[h1]New Ship's Editor[/h1]

We made a major change in the ship's editor. Do you remember those screenshots of space station? It looked pretty lifeless, like a chaotic heap of cargo containers without any connections between them.

When we faced with this problem (and with Artaani's perfectionism) we decided throw out the "tiles based" editor and instead of that, we made it "joints based", The GIF animation below should explain how it works. Besides, we decided to add the “corridors” which should connect all ship's parts together to allow you transfer resources from one part to another.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/27.10.2014_1.gif[/img]

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/2014-10-23_015637.png[/img]

And now it looks much better! This ship now feels alive! Besides, the new “joints based” system brings some additional benefits!
The maximum size of the ship is no longer limited. And now we're able to add parts of any form. For example, in discussion you're suggested to make armor blocks, so now we can do it. It will looks like a thin armor plate which can be attached to another module.

Besides, we finally have implemented system of ship's destruction. Just look at that.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/27.10.2014_2.gif[/img]

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/27.10.2014_3.gif[/img]


[h1]User Interface Improvement[/h1]

While Artaani working on new editor, I'm with Romenics started working on some changes in UI.

We noticed that current UI is slightly inconvenient. For example when you select solar panel, the “deploy” button appears on the top-left corner of the screen, it is too far from solar panel which are in the center of the screen so you need move your view between those two points.

This is why we decided that control panel should appears near selected object. Or maybe we just should make it dragable. Not sure, still trying various decisions.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/2014-10-27_204004.png[/img]

Besides, we slightly changed the design, we trying to make more bright design like in some Sci-Fi movies. But make it convenient and functional, without bunch of useless and distracting graphic elements.


[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]

Yes! We continue working on it! Actually, we're have started working on multiplayer some time ago, but we faced with one technical problem. We even thought that multiplayer in the Celestial Command it is too difficult task. But today we was focused on this problem and we solve it!

So now we can safely say – Celestial Command will have multiplayer. It's only a matter of time. Actually, now we're focused on multiplayer, because any game with multiplayer is much, much better then without it.

But anyway, multiplayer is pretty complicated task. You're probably noticed that very small amount of indie games have a multiplayer. But we'll make it! Just want to remind you that when the game will be released it will be in "Early Access" and many features will be unavailable. But we will implement new features as soon as possible.

We are really want to make a good impression and don't get a bad reputation of "unfinished, early access, money grabber game".


Stay in touch for further interesting news! )

notes.title: Lagrangian Points and Tidal Force
notes.content:
In the discussion you are asked is there a Lagrangian points?
The answer is no.
But this is pretty important question for everyone who is familiar with orbital mechanics, so let's describe it in more detail.

[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lagrangian_point]Lagrangian point,[/url] briefly, is a point where two nearest celestial body affect on the ship with the equal gravity force.

In order for this phenomenon to be possible - ships should be affected by gravity from more than one nearest celestial bodies (planets or moons), like in the real world.
But in the Celestial Command, only one nearest planet affect the ship. But why?

There is two reason.
First one, optimization. Gravity calculation to one planet gives better performance then to all planets in the system. But this is not important reason.
Another more important reason is tidal forces.

Let me explain. As we know, the closer object is to the planet - the more powerful gravity affect it. For example.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/TidalForceExplanation.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/TidalForceExplanation.png[/img][/url]

The moon is pulling point A stronger than point B and this is called tidal force. And that's why tides exists
But lets imagine a ship on the Earth's orbit. When it passes above point A it will be attracted by the Moon and its orbit will be deformed so much so stable orbiting will be impossible.

Actually, the same phenomenon exist in the real life. But it is relative to the distances between celestial bodies. For example orbit height of the International Space Station is 420 km. And distance to the Moon is 380 000 km. So while ISS rotating around the Earth, distance between ISS and Moon changes only slghtly, so orbit is not deformed that much.

But in the Celestial Command distances are much shorter thus said, orbits are deforming quite a bit..

So this is why we decided to simplify the orbital mechanics in Celestial Command.

And distance to the Moon is 380 000 km. So while ISS rotating around the Earth, distance between ISS and Moon changes only slghtly, so orbit is not deformed that much.

But in the Celestial Command distances are much shorter thus said, orbits are deforming quite a bit..

So this is why we decided to simplify the orbital mechanics in Celestial Command.

notes.content:
[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/2014-10-12_220143.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/2014-10-12_220143.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Logistics, Mining and Space Stations
notes.content:
[i]This post was started before we has been Greenlit. So, let's continue![/i]

Hi! Long time no news, and I'll make it right.
That's what we can to show you today.

One another reason to build a space station, we have added a new module, a grabber. The grabber is able to cling to any objects, so you can organize a mining station right on the asteroid.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/1_18.09.14.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/1_18.09.14.png[/img][/url]

First of all it is convenient for logistics and storage of ore, and if you provide it with enough amount of power, you can start a production right on the space station.

Production station near asteroids with ice is an important refueling point. Ice can be melted into water which can be split into oxygen and hydrogen which are the fuel for a rocket engines.

Now construction of the parts requires resources, they are no longer free. Extraction and storage of resources will be one of your tasks.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2_18.09.14.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2_18.09.14.png[/img][/url]

Due to the fact that all objects inside a container increases its mass, logistics and management of the center of mass becomes a serious challenge for the player. We will try to provide convenient tools for inventory management, but even with them, you will have to think about how to build your transport ship properly.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/3_18.09.14.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/3_18.09.14.png[/img][/url]

When scanning a asteroids you can see a content of the its sectors. We are not very satisfied about asteroid interface, so we will enhance it later.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/4_18.09.14.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/4_18.09.14.png[/img][/url]

And note the scale. The whole station it's just a little object in the orbit.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/5_18.09.14.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/5_18.09.14.png[/img][/url]

Rotating around the planet...

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/6_18.09.14.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/6_18.09.14.png[/img][/url]

...which rotates around the star.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/7_18.09.14.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/7_18.09.14.png[/img][/url]

So far there is only one star system. But it's procedural generated and later we will implement interstellar traveling with warp drive or gates.

We was just astonished that occupied the 38th place! And now we astonished even more that we are have been Greenlit so quick!
Thanks to everyone who helped us and told others about us!

notes.title: Resource Storage System
notes.content:
[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/StorageSystem_1.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/StorageSystem_1.png[/img][/url]

Hello dear followers!

Resource storage system have been implemented. It's a little unusual. How it works?
There is no one inventory for all type of items. Instead, there is a specific type of container for a specific things. Power storages, ore containers, tanks for liquids and gases.

And as in real life, one ore container can contain only one type of ore. Well, of course, in real life you can fill it with any type of an ore. But after that will be pretty hard to divide the ore. So in the game we decide to make containers only for one type.

When you press a button, you will see icon above each container and you can move content by drag and drop.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/StorageSystem_2.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/StorageSystem_2.png[/img][/url]

So generally, it's pretty the same as classic inventory from RPG, but each container have own mass and volume. So amount of cells in your "inventory" depends on amount of containers on the ship. Max size of an "ore stack" depends on the max volume of the specific container! Besides, if some container will be destroyed, you will loose specific "inventory cell" with their content.

Also, will be important where exactly do you place containers, because content in them affect on the center of mass of the ship.

Our next goal is improvement of craft and mining system.

See you soon! :)

notes.title: Prototype of Space Station
notes.content:
[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/space_station_prototype_1.jpg[/img]

Hm... Well... More like bunch of randomly placed parts, not like space station. :) But anyway! Even this can be useful to make some conclusions.
First of all. It cute. :) And what is more important. It useful.

Mass of the cargo containers now depends on the content. And miner ships that gather full container of resources are become really heavy.
Empty container have a mass of 7 tons. But when it fully loaded with iron ore it may have a mass up to 100 tons. Or even more. So, assembling space station on the orbit will be a nice idea.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/space_station_prototype_2.jpg[/img]

By the way. Each resource have own density like in real world. It means that full container of cuprum is more heavy than full container of aluminium.

Seems like that station now lacks some kind of transport corridors. All these cargo containers looks slightly unrealistic without entrances and exits.also space become slighty 

Today was implemented a grabber that can grab any object, including asteroids. So you can catch asteroids and throw it into bad guys.

Space background become more beautiful. But we don't want to fill it with "rainbows". Space will remain nice and clean so as not to distract the player.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/space_station_prototype_3.jpg[/img]

Tomorrow will be something interesting. See you soon. :)

notes.title: Prototype of Space Station
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7217616/5e0df22156f1568e6913615891b22f3c582cbe4a.jpg[/img]

Hm... Well... More like bunch of randomly placed parts, not like space station. :) But anyway! Even this can be useful to make some conclusions.
First of all. It cute. :) And what is more important. It useful.

Mass of the cargo containers now depends on the content. And miner ships that gather full container of resources are become really heavy.
Empty container have a mass of 7 tons. But when it fully loaded with iron ore it may have a mass up to 100 tons. Or even more. So, assembling space station on the orbit will be a nice idea.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7217616/fe78065d4bf4727ee849b186c68a0f8a9ddf648c.jpg[/img]

By the way. Each resource have own density like in real world. It means that full container of cuprum is more heavy than full container of aluminium.

Seems like that station now lacks some kind of transport corridors. All these cargo containers looks slightly unrealistic without entrances and exits.also space become slighty 

Today was implemented a grabber that can grab any object, including asteroids. So you can catch asteroids and throw it into bad guys.

Space background become more beautiful. But we don't want to fill it with "rainbows". Space will remain nice and clean so as not to distract the player.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7217616/88bf187a0a80c955b9f56790b5a7779fcb9aded7.jpg[/img]

Tomorrow will be something interesting. See you soon. :)

notes.title: Fuel Consumption and Mining System
notes.content:
Today was the day of the programming. Many bug fixes, not so many interesting things.
Engines now property consume fuel. Mining are partially implemented.

Let's talk about a mining.
Each asteroid is divided by several sectors. 8 for example. Each sector contains some random amount of random ore and can be mined individually. So if you want to mine whole asteroid. You should fly around it.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-11_032617.png[/img]

When all sector are depleted asteroid will shatter and disappear. Or not. Haven't decided yet with this.
There will be a scanners which can scan asteroids and reveal content of nearest sectors.

Also mining lasers seems like not very realistic idea. We want to replace it with some kind of robotic mining arms. Something like this.

[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/miner_concept.jpg[/img]

It should be more interesting.

Now we will work on resource transfer system through docking port. Refilling of the ships on the industrial space station should be amazing.

See you soon. :)

notes.title: Craft System (Part 2) and new Greenlight statistics
notes.content:
Hello again dear followers!
Any object in the game has a mass, even if it is loaded in the cargo bay, it increases the total mass of the ship, so, the bigger the mass, the harder it is to accelerate the entire ship. And this means need more fuel.

Now maximum size of the ship is 32x32 cells. But we can extend this limit if it will be not enough. But for now it seems good.
[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/max_size_32.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/max_size_32.png[/img][/url]

Also you can extend ship size by docking one to another.

Couple of words about shipbuilding process. Each module appears instantly after placement, but after that it need to be builded by drones. Each drone is automatic unit like a workers in RTS. You can control them by mouse and give several orders by shift+clicking.
[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/build_process.gif[/img]
Also we thought to do the manual construction. So you need to hold your left mouse button on the unfinished module. But then we decide that it's too boring and we are implement RTS like workers.
What do you think?

And some new Greenlight statistics.
[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-09_002244.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-09_002244.png[/img][/url]
Amazing! 62% for 3 days! Thanks you all for your votes and feedbacks!

See you soon!
[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-08_225647.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-08_225647.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Craft System (Part 1)
notes.content:
So, let's talk about craft.

This system is not final. If you are have ideas about how to make it better, you are free to express it and let's try to make it better together.

[h1]Basic resources[/h1]
First you need to gather basic resources. Now you can get it from asteroids. In future you will be able to extract it from planets.

There is a full list of resources for now:

Carbon
Aluminium
Silicon
Silver
Titanium
Iron
Cobalt
Nickel
Cuprum
Niobium

Oxygen
Hydrogen
Xenon

Ice
Fullerite
Deuterium

As you can see, we decided to not invent anything and implemented real elements.

[h1]Processing[/h1]
Then you need to build a module to refine these resources.

Any metal ore → Refined metal
Ice → Oxygen and Hydrogen
Hydrogen → Deuterium
Carbon → Fullerite

There will be several resource processors:
electric furnace
water electrolysis module

Each processor unit require power to work.
Power is generated from solar panels and generators. And generator required a fuel.

[h1]Parts[/h1]
Then you need to build modules parts. There is full list:

Metal Plate
Tube
Electric motor
Wires
Battery
Capasitor
Control circuit
Fasteners Kit
Armored Plate
Magnet
Superconductor

It can be builded in production module from refined resources.
[img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-08_015339.png[/img]
And finally, engineering drones can assemble ship's modules from these parts.

notes.title: New craft icons
notes.content:
Hello dear followers!
Today we productively spent a time and lets us show you a current progress. But first a little introduction.

The games consist of many things. Some of them, user don't even noticed.
One of these things is icons.
Players may noticed that icons is nice. But usually they don't think that they are also require time to creation. We are also think so before we start to develop this game. ;)

So, let's talk about a progress. First we are trying to draw icons in 2D editors, but you know, with 3D is much more easy to work then 2D. Although many people believe the opposite.
So we are modeling all icons in the 3D editor and render them into image.
We using Blender, it's amazing open-source 3d editor.

[url=http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-07_231038.png][img]http://celestialcommand.com/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/2014-09-07_231038.png[/img][/url]

And what we have for now. That's not all icons. But for now looks pretty nice.

See you soon!

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]How much this game will cost?[/h1]

Until the game will be in early access it will cost 8$.
When all amazing features will be implemented, including multiplayer, after stable release it will cost 16$.
Therefore, during the early access it has a discount -50%!

Some developers set the price for early access higher than after release, making money on the thirsty players.
We are not going to do that!

Actually, people who participate in early access make a great assistance for developers. They are making bug reports and send their ideas that helps to make the game much better. And most importantly, their feedback is really important because they give us enthusiasm, which allows us to continue to develop the project!

[h1]When is a release date?[/h1]

First of all, it depends on you! :) Help us as soon as possible get on Steam by voting for us on Greenlight. And we will open early access as soon as we solve all organizational issues.

What about the final release, we implement all main features in the next couple of months. By the way, you can follow the progress on our blog!

[h1]On what platforms is game will be available?[/h1]

For now we are focused on the PC. But then we have a plan to release on Windows Phone, Linux and Android. With cross platform multiplayer, of course.

[h1]Where I can buy a game after release?[/h1]

For PC and Linux, it will only be sold on [b]Steam[/b]. We believe that this is the most promising and convenient platform for selling games and don't see the sense in alternative stores.

[h1]Where can I know about the development progress and future plans?[/h1]

We have a development blog where you can know a lot of interesting things about the various aspects of development!

[h1]The game will have a multiplayer?[/h1]

Yes, but not now. At the beginning of early access, the game will have only a singleplayer. But then we will add multiplayer through LAN and direct IP connection.

[h1]Where can I offer my ideas or make a bug report?[/h1]

We are really welcome your desire to express your ideas about the game!

The best way to do this it's a start new discussions
on our Greenlight page.
Also you can send email for us in CelestialCommand@yandex.com

We have disabled the ability to comment in the blog, because we don't want to force you to register on our site and allow you to use your Steam account. But unfortunately we are not very good at web development and we could not implement the possibility of login through Steam on our website. So we decided to duplicate all blog posts and make all discussion on the our Greenlight page.

[h1]Do you plan to translate the game into other languages?[/h1]

Not for now. The game has not so much text, so it's not a priority. But then we'll do something with this issue.

[h1]What engine is game made in?[/h1]

We use the amazing [url=http://unity3d.com][b]Unity3d[/b][/url] engine. We do not use any content from Unity Asset Store and all code is written in C#. Also all models created with [url=http://www.blender.org][b]Blender[/b][/url].

notes.title: Scale of Star System
notes.content:
You know, when we started to develop this game, there was not the planets and orbits. There was friction in space, maximum speed limit and the only key feature was a limited fuel and ability to capture parts of enemy ships. We wanted to call the game “Salvage Command”.

How well that we have changed the concept.
Once we thought: Hey! Vaccum friction? It’s a silly! Why all action space games ignore the realism?
Beautiful Kerbal Space Program already tell to the world about real space. Actually, KSP and Simple Rockets inspired us to bring realism in our space games.

So there we start to develop Celestial Command.
The main idea is unite classic action space game with realistic orbital mechanics. So scale of star system should be changed for more action.

Celestial Command will have a multiplayer, so we cannot use time scale and fast traveling between a planets. Instead of this, we decided to make star system smaller, so travel between planets will takes something around 10-20 minutes. And while your ship in travel you can switch to another ship and do something else.

[h1]Let’s talk in numbers[/h1]

Most likely we will change it, but for now we have next:

Sizes:
Average ship size 10 m
Planet diameters 100-400 m
Star radius 2 km

Average orbital period of the ship on the planet orbit is 2-7 minutes.
Average orbital period of the planet on the star orbit is 6-20 minutes.

If you’re familiar with astronomy, those numbers may seem funny, but our goal is not reliable reconstruction, we want to create pretty simple action space game with a bit of realism.

[h1]Where is the moon?[/h1]

You are probably noticed that planet don’t have a natural satellites.
The problem is that planets even now is small relative to a ship. And if we’ll add satellites, they should be just a tiny So we decide do not add natural satellites to the game.
And we cannot enlarge the planets, because of then we need to enlarge distance between planets and then interplanetary traveling will become boring.
